title: City Council District 1
statement: Brooklyn's numbers this week are not abstract to me — Kaila Raimon, Drago Helio, Sefu Helio, and Minh Raimon live with the sentiment reading of -0.09 while the city sits at 0.115, and a transformer blowout on top of it. That is inside my district, and it is not new. I'm not going to call a quiet number a catastrophe, and I'm not going to let it be waved away either. The director wants the Brooklyn service audit baseline and the District 1 dispatch evaluation for the Alternative Response Initiative on the record; I'll file that answer, because if the audit exists, the neighbors who live with it get to see it. West Oakland, meanwhile, built its own good mood — sentiment at 0.41, retail at 12.6 — and I intend to keep saying that out loud. My continuing work is the Tenant Defense Fund, on the board again at C115, and I will not let procedural silence answer tenant defense.
